text:
Landing at Kansai Airport at 21:30, staying in Kyoto?
By the time you clear immigration,
the last Haruka (22:16) may be gone.
The bus keeps running until 23:20 👇

👉 Our late-landing plan, in 3 steps:
https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-kyoto

⏰ Step 1: check the clock, not just the price
The Haruka is faster, about 75–80 minutes.
But on weekdays the last one leaves at 22:16.
The last bus leaves Terminal 1 at 23:20.

🚌 Step 2: know how the bus works
💴 ¥2,800, cash or ICOCA on board.
No reservations: first come, first seated.
Buses run roughly every 20 minutes.

🏨 Step 3: sleep near the Hachijo Exit
The bus stops opposite Kyoto Station's south exit.
A short walk to bed, not a taxi queue at 1 a.m.

🎫 Flying in earlier?
Then the Haruka wins.
On 1 November 2026, the visitor one-way ticket
went up from ¥2,200 to ¥2,700.

👉 Where to sleep for a late arrival:
https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-kyoto

What time does your flight land?
Tell us in the comments,
and we'll say which one we'd take.
